claim_scope: Controlled one-entry/one-exit action replays across source month/direction strata using current local US100 M1 bars and TickBook quotes matched to unique, complete source timestamp groups in the recorded local quote-alignment scan. These are not historical policy replays or provider-clock validation.
limitations: The action sequence is controlled and does not reproduce a campaign policy.
The quote scan preserves the configured parser's per-side carry and price-grid rules.
The data's timestamp ties do not establish within-tie source chronology.
Market impact and broker-specific effects are not modeled.
selection_rule: At most one pair per source month and direction, selected in chronological order using unique complete quote groups reproduced by the current TickBook; no PnL-based selection.
timezone_limitation: Configured local timestamp interpretation; no external clock authority assessed.
